protocol.method: Live fix-pair A/B: the change-review droid source contract reviewed real culprit diffs mined from Factory's private monorepo merged fix PRs, one run per candidate model, with per-run factory_credits and findings captured by scripts/run-review-fixpairs.mjs.
protocol.history: 2026-07-11-role-routing assigned gpt-5.6-sol:xhigh without comparative evidence. On 2026-07-30 eight human-verified fix pairs (fp-0001, fp-0003, fp-0005, fp-0012, fp-0013, fp-0034, fp-0059, fp-0089) were reviewed by gpt-5.6-sol, glm-5.2, and kimi-k3.
protocol.artifactPolicy: Run artifacts contain private monorepo content and stay local under evals/runs/ (gitignored); this record carries only scrubbed aggregates.

decision.rationale: gpt-5.6-sol cost 5-10x more per review (1.29M-2.34M factory credits) than glm-5.2 (0.13M-0.42M) or kimi-k3 (0.18M-0.20M) with no recall advantage: on fp-0001 sol returned a verified clean verdict over the labeled defect region (0 findings) while kimi-k3 emitted 2 findings, and kimi led or tied findings counts on the other completed pairs. kimi-k3 documents only off/high (docs.factory.ai/models); max is pinned per explicit repo-owner decision, and the CLI accepts unlisted effort values silently, so max may execute as high. The measured runs requested xhigh, which the CLI likewise accepted without the model being able to honor it.

limitations: One rep per pair per model; region-hit classification (scripts/score-fixpairs.mjs) was not completed before this decision, so findings counts are not region-verified recall.
glm-5.2 supports only off/high/max (docs.factory.ai/models); sweep data labeled 'glm52-low' from 2026-07-30 requested an effort the model does not have and is disregarded.
security, pr-describer, quick-analysis, and doc-generator pins are unchanged: their comparative runs were not fully verified.
Promotion to validated requires completing score-fixpairs classification across the completed runs and a second rep on divergent pairs.
